description: NaGd₃GeS₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent S atoms to form face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.71 Å) and three longer (2.74 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Gd-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.32 Å. Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and three longer (2.25 Å) Ge-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three equivalent Gd and one Ge atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Gd atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Gd and one Ge atom.
